page.overview:
Who is Aquafend?

The Aquaspeeders' intelligence expert, Aquafend is an expert in disguise and espionage. He has also spent a lot of time studying the Decepticon mindset, so that he can predict their actions before they can commit them.

(Hint: They're gonna do something eeeeevil.)
